name: @kalo-ai/plugin-example
description: Reference Kalo AI plugin demonstrating tools, settings, prompt extensions, and migration

scripts.prepack: bun run clean && bun run build
scripts.publish:npm: if [ -t 0 ] && [ -t 1 ]; then npm publish --access public; else echo 'Interactive npm publish needs a TTY. Run: cd packages/plugin-example && npm publish --access public' >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.publish:jsr: if [ -t 0 ] && [ -t 1 ]; then bun run prepare:jsr && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && cd ./.jsr-publish && deno publish --set-version "$VERSION"; else echo 'Interactive JSR publish needs a TTY. Run bun run publish:jsr from packages/plugin-example.' >&2; exit 1; fi
